The numbers √2,α,β are rationally independent, so Kronecker gives a dense positive-time 3-torus orbit. The factor coefficient spaces have dimensions ≤3 and ≤5; constant stochastic sum cuts affine dimension to ≤14, so Carathéodory bounds support by 15. Numerical LP is not the proof; times are existential and unbounded.
